sources.title: Parks Canada, Château Laurier National Historic Site
sources.inspection: Read defining Indiana limestone, octagonal front pavilions, oriels, steep copper roofs, round inset corner tower and arcaded entrance.

sources.title: NCC 2008 Château Laurier development guidelines
sources.inspection: Inspected phase diagram, aerial and section. Original L, 1929 U, later garage are distinguished; do not build proposed envelopes.

sources.title: ERA Architects, revised Cultural Heritage Impact Statement, 23 December 2020
sources.inspection: Read existing/proposed scope and inspected PDF page 108, architectsAlliance A_2.3 west elevation. Existing hotel silhouette, floor spacing, terrace base and relative roof heights guide interpretation; dimension labels describe proposed addition only.

sources.title: Satellite roof context
sources.inspection: Individually inspected historic U, lower central hall roof, angled northwest and northeast wings, entrance roof and open rear parking lot.

sources.title: NRCan HRDEM Mosaic DTM
sources.inspection: Raw 1 m ground-elevation GeoTIFF retained and sampled in EPSG:3979. Independent street datum 72.0103 m CGVD2013, canal-side footprint drop about six metres. No flattening or model fitting.
